meta.author: Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur
meta.first_line: jīva jāga, jīva jāga, gorāchā̐da bale

text: jīva jāga, jīva jāga, gorāchā̐da bale
translation: Lord Gaurāṅga calls, “Wake up, sleeping souls! Wake up, sleeping souls! You have slept so long in the lap of the witch Māyā.

text: (uṭha jīva, kṛṣṇa bhaja ār kata kāl ghumāibe?)
translation: (“How much longer will you sleep? How much longer will you sleep in the lap of the witch Māyā? Arise soul! Serve Kṛṣṇa! How much longer will you sleep?)
“You came into this world saying, ‘O my Lord, I will certainly worship You’, but having forgotten this promise, you have remained in great ignorance.
(“Having forgotten, you have remained there. You have fallen into the bewilderment of ignorance, and, having forgotten your promise, you have remained there.)

text: āmi vinā bandhu āra ke āchhe tomāra
translation: “I have descended just to save you. Other than Myself, who else is your friend?

text: (māyā ha-ite uddhārite eman bandhu ār ke āchhe?)
translation: (“Who else is such a friend? Who else is such a friend to rescue you from Māyā?)
“I have brought the medicine for destroying the illusion of māyā. Now pray for this Hari-nāma Mahāmantra and take it.”
(“O pray and take it. O pray and take this Name of Hari which is coated with nectar.”)
Ṭhākur Bhakti Vinod fell at the lotus feet of Lord Gaurāṅga, and after begging for the Holy Name he received that Mahāmantra.
